a.title: Life's machinery, drawn by Kosika
a.summary: A DNA double helix turning, its bases paired by Kosika, and a neuron sending a signal down its axon.

beats.text: DNA is two strands wound round each other, joined by base pairs.
A always pairs with T and G with C, so one strand spells out the other.
A neuron gathers signals on its dendrites and fires down its axon.
Myelin wraps the axon so the signal jumps along quickly to the terminals.
